name: list_project_connector_connections
description:
List the connectors connected to a project and the environments where each connection is available.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/connect/projects/{projectId}/connectors --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cursor.description: Cursor from `pagination.next` on the previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of connector connections to return. Defaults to 50.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
